metadata.name: schema-migrations
metadata.description: Schema migrations integration family. Concrete providers (goose-postgres, flyway-mysql, mongo-migrate, native-sql) implement subsets of these operations. Migrations are versioned, ordered, idempotent; checksum guards against silent mutation of already-applied versions.

spec.description: Generic contract for any provider that applies versioned schema migrations against a target datastore. Migration.Up and Migration.Down are arbitrary JSON payloads — providers parse their own shape (SQL providers conventionally use {"sql": "..."}). The family enforces ordering, idempotency, and checksum-based drift detection; provider chooses how to talk to the engine.

operations.name: apply_migrations_spec
operations.description: Apply a list of versioned migrations in order. Idempotent. Rejects checksum drift on already-applied versions.

operations.name: describe_applied_migrations
operations.description: List already-applied migrations (version, applied_at, checksum). Used for drift detection and dashboards.

operations.name: rollback_migration
operations.description: Rollback last migration (mode=single) or down to a target version (mode=down_to). Providers that cannot rollback return status=unsupported.
